warnings: No obvious status-quo or baseline alternative was found.
metadata.sampling_design: Stratified scenario allocation with a declared latent-factor Gaussian copula, shared shocks across alternatives, marginal-preserving inverse transforms, and matched independent/correlation-stress counterfactuals.

decision.title: Population Health Evidence Design
decision.domain: Biostatistics, clinical research, health data science, and population health
decision.question: Choose an evaluation design for a community prevention program that balances statistical precision, representativeness, time, cost, and operational burden.
blocking_reasons: evidence is not labeled for operational use
decision.feasibility_basis: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on simulated constraint-breach frequency

registry-observational.label: Registry-based observational study
registry-observational.description: Link routine-care records and estimate adjusted associations without randomized assignment.

parallel-rct.label: Conventional parallel RCT
parallel-rct.description: Randomize eligible participants at fixed sites using a pre-specified sample size.

adaptive-stratified.label: Adaptive stratified pragmatic trial
adaptive-stratified.description: Randomize within population strata and use pre-specified adaptations for recruitment and information accrual.

stepped-wedge.label: Cluster stepped-wedge trial
stepped-wedge.description: Randomize implementation timing across community sites while all sites eventually receive the program.

factors.label: Systemic adverse demand and delivery shock
factors.description: A shared latent shock moves outcome distributions across criteria and alternatives in the adverse direction; signs follow each criterion's value direction.

evidence.type: Synthetic pilot, recruitment, outcome-rate, and study-operations assumptions
evidence.as_of: Synthetic demonstration; no production as-of date
sources: Illustrative two-group pilot dataset bundled with the case
evidence.causal_claim_status: No causal conclusion; the case compares study designs, while the companion evidence module reports descriptive effect estimates and uncertainty.
limitations: Power is represented by a precision score rather than a full design-specific simulation.
Site and participant outcomes may be correlated.
The bundled individual-level dataset is synthetic and too small for clinical inference.
The Gaussian copula and factor loadings are synthetic assumptions; tail dependence may differ in real data and requires domain approval.

decision_notes: A real protocol requires a statistician-approved estimand, power simulation, multiplicity plan, missing-data strategy, and data-monitoring plan.
The adaptive design must pre-specify adaptation rules and preserve type-I error control.
